notes: The two narrators of «قالا حدثنا أنس بن عياض» each name a different man after Anas, in their own version: «حدثني ابن أبي ذباب، في رواية هارون» and «وفي حديث الأنصاري حدثني الحارث». Read as two groups; the shared tail is Abd al-Rahman then Abu Hurayra.
«مولى أبي هريرة» is an epithet of Abd al-Rahman, left out; the Companion is the second «أبي هريرة» (after «عن»).
The dashed clause could be read as an editor's gloss; it is read as the route of Haroun's narration because the text says «في رواية هارون».
